summary: Wetour Robotics Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its Extraordinary General Meeting held August 24, 2026. Shareholders approved a 100:1 share consolidation (every 100 shares of $0.0001 par value into one $0.01 share), an increase in authorized share capital from US$100,000 divided into 10 million shares to US$20 billion divided into 2 trillion shares, and adoption of a second amended and restated memorandum and articles of association. Votes were overwhelmingly in favor. This is a routine corporate governance and capital structure event, not a special-situation transaction.
